kda.name: K/DA
kda.description: Collect 4 K/DA Cards to earn an extra Augment. Pick a bonus Augment after round 4.

pentakill.name: Pentakill
pentakill.description: Empower a basic Ability at the start, then another at the end. Even your Ultimate!

heartsteel.name: HEARTSTEEL
heartsteel.description: Members may put Stickers on your Augments. Pick a stickered Augment for a bonus.

true-damage.name: True Damage
true-damage.description: Multi-kills, shutdowns, and destroying towers hype the crowd into dropping Anvils.

disco.name: Disco
disco.description: Boogie down until the Disco Ball drops, granting everyone 1,000 gold.

bees.name: Bees
bees.description: Collect the honey pots and avoid the bees that fly across the map.

command-line.name: Command Line
command-line.description: Only Silver and Gold Augments appear. Your first reroll each round raises that Augment one tier.

skillBonus: Gains 20 Ability Haste and 10% increased damage, [h]healing[/h], and [b]shielding[/b].
